title: Drinking Water — Specification
scope: Requirements for drinking water: organoleptic, physical, general, toxic, bacteriological, virological, biological and radioactive parameters, with acceptable and permissible limits.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
scope: Treated water packaged for human consumption. Under compulsory BIS certification; an FSSAI licence is separately required.

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification
scope: Water from natural or drilled underground sources, packaged near the source without treatment altering its mineral composition. Under compulsory BIS certification.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Part 1: Safety Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps operating above 50 V. Certified through the Compulsory Registration Scheme, not the ISI mark.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Part 2: Performance Requirements
scope: Performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps operating above 50 V.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: General safety requirements for household electrical appliances up to 250 V single-phase and 480 V otherwise. Read together with the Part 2 section for the specific appliance.
